title: FNAF Jumpscare Scream
blurb: The Five Nights at Freddy's jumpscare scream — the shriek that launched a thousand reaction videos. This is the sound of an animatronic deciding your shift is over. A decade later it still triggers fight-or-flight in anyone who played FNAF at a formative age. Use it for jump scares, fake-outs, and pranking friends with headphones. Volume warning very much intended.
origin: The animatronic jumpscare scream from Five Nights at Freddy's (2014).
